body:
# ⚡ Refined Essentials
Double Your FPS | Essential Client-Side Pack
Stop lagging. Start dominating.

This pack is engineered for one purpose: to double your Minecraft performance while equipping you with the essential HUD features you need to play better. Whether you are grinding PvP, exploring vast worlds, or building end-game bases, this pack strips away the bloat and keeps the power.

We have combined heavy-weight optimization mods with practical utilities like a Minimap, Armor Hud, and Zoom to give you a competitive edge without sacrificing your FPS.

Perfect for: PvP, Survival, Low-end PCs, and competitive gameplay.

🚀 "**Double Your Performance**" — The Reality
We take performance seriously. By combining industry-standard optimization mods, this pack drastically reduces rendering lag and stuttering. You aren't just gaining a few FPS; you are fundamentally changing how the game renders.

**Why you get double the speed**:

**Sodium** : The gold standard for rendering optimization. Rewrites the rendering engine to be incredibly fast. 

**Modern Fix & FerriteCore**: Drastically reduces RAM usage (Memory leaks are gone). 

**Entity Culling**: Stops the game from rendering things behind you or inside walls. Boosts FPS instantly.

**Result**: Smoother chunk loading, higher FPS in dense forests, and stable frame times in PvP._

### 🗺️ Essential HUD & Utility Features
While the pack is a speed demon, it doesn't forget the user experience. You get the "must-have" mods without the clutter.

**🧭 Xaero's Minimap & World Map**

Never get lost again. Fully customizable fair-play map.

Waypoints to mark your base, nether fortress, or friend's house. 

**🛡️ Armor Hud & Status Effects**

Displays your armor durability, tool health right next to your hotbar and potion timer on top.

**🔍 Zoomify**

Bind it to a key (Default: C) and instantly zoom into the distance.

Perfect for spotting enemies, reading signs, or scouting a village. 

**✨ Visual & Quality of Life**

Dynamic FPS: Reduces lag when tabbed out.

**📦 Included Mods Overview**

This pack is built on Fabric for maximum speed.

### 📥 Installation & Requirements
Download: Use the Modrinth App (Recommended) or manual download.

Loader: Fabric (Installed automatically by the App). 

Memory: Allocate at least 2GB (4GB Recommended).

Compatibility: Fully Client-Side. You can join any vanilla or paper server!
